> Personal engineering portfolio of Mahmoud Magdy, a Full Stack Engineer at Okaab based in Alexandria, Egypt, specializing in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and accessible web architecture.

## Selected Projects
- [Social App](https://github.com/mahmoudmagdyedu/Social-App-Route): React, TypeScript, and Vite social application featuring client-side routing, authentication, posts, comments, profiles, and form validation. Live demo: https://social-app-route-one.vercel.app
- [Okaab](https://github.com/mahmoudmagdyedu/okaab-software-agency): Unified web platform bringing together the agency site, administration, and learning experience using React, TypeScript, and TanStack Start. Website: https://okaab.org
- [TaskFlow](https://github.com/mahmoudmagdyedu/Task-Board-App): TypeScript and Tailwind CSS Kanban board with drag-and-drop task management, form validation, and local persistence. Live demo: https://taskflow.mahmoudmagdy.page/
- [Baassma](https://baassma.tech): Arabic interactive learning platform for hands-on practice in programming, networking, and electronics with browser-based labs.
- [Little Lemon](https://github.com/malejandr71/little-lemon-capstone): Accessible restaurant reservation flow built with React and Vite, featuring responsive layouts, form validation, and automated tests.
